input.body:
label: bug
file: src/util/dates.ts

`startOfWeek` ignores the `tz` parameter entirely (see the `// TODO: honour tz` comment) and computes the week boundary using UTC date fields. For a user in Sydney (UTC+10/11), the UTC-based week boundary falls on a different local calendar day than for users in London, which combined with `isRollupDue`'s correct per-timezone hour check in `rollup.ts` causes the rollup to be considered "due" a day later than expected locally, so the Monday summary goes out Tuesday morning for Sydney users while London users (close to UTC) are unaffected.
